task.description:
Implement PIN-03, PIN-04, PIN-05, PRM-01 per the four design artefacts CODE-DESIGN-VALIDATOR just PASSed: src/design/pin-03-no-fallback-to-latest-version.md, src/design/pin-04-pin-resolution-on-replay-and-sub-processes.md, src/design/pin-05-explicit-instance-pin-rebind.md, src/design/prm-01-promotion-plan-and-diff-report.md. Read each design artefact in full before touching any code -- they specify exact interfaces, data flow, error taxonomy, and (for PIN-03) an explicit scoped-substitute for AC3, which is genuinely blocked on the same service_catalog version/status gap as PIN-01 AC1/AC2 (tracked ISS-0672/GH-306, still OPEN -- do not attempt to add version/status columns to service_catalog yourself, that decision is out of scope per the design's Open questions).

PIN-03 (no fallback to latest): add execution-time PinMissing enforcement -- when a node executes and its reference has no entry in the resolved pin set, raise typed PinMissing and route through the standard retry-then-dead-letter path (reuse existing retry/dead-letter machinery, do not build a new one). Verify no code path substitutes the current active version for a missing pin. AC3 (DEPRECATED-after-start) is scoped per the design's structural substitute -- implement exactly what the design specifies there, nothing more.

PIN-04 (replay + sub-process inheritance): state reconstruction reads the effective pin set from INSTANCE_STARTED and the latest INSTANCE_PINS_REBOUND event only -- never the live catalog. Sub-process children inherit the parent's pin set, adding entries only for refs the parent doesn't carry; a child ref that resolves to a version differing from an inherited pin uses the inherited one and records the conflict. New GET /api/v1/instances/{id}/pins endpoint returns the effective set with each entry's source event identifier.

PIN-05 (explicit rebind): new POST /api/v1/instances/{id}/rebind-pins endpoint. Takes explicit {kind, ref, version} entries plus a mandatory reason. Appends INSTANCE_PINS_REBOUND recording prior version, new version, actor, and reason for each changed entry. All-or-nothing; rejected (409 InstanceNotRebindable) on a terminal instance (COMPLETED/CANCELLED/FAILED); rejects (422 UnknownPinRef) a ref absent from the current pin set, applying none of the entries; rejects (422) a request missing the reason field.

PRM-01 (promotion plan and diff report): compute a promotion plan BEFORE any write to the target tenant. Diffs source vs target tenant's definition version across process graph, variable_schema, service catalog bindings, module_ref values, and permission rules. Each plan entry carries {type, id, change_kind, before, after} with change_kind in added/modified/removed. New POST /api/v1/promotions endpoint gated on promotion.submit permission (403 + no promotion_reviews row if caller lacks it -- design clarified PRM-01 itself does NOT persist a promotion_reviews row, that belongs to a later requirement PRM-04; verify this against the design before writing any migration). Target tenant holding no version of process_key -> every entry change_kind=added, plan accepted. Identical-after-canonicalisation source/target -> 422 EmptyPromotionPlan. source_tenant_id naming a production tenant -> 422 InvalidPromotionSource. Reuses/extends existing src/definition/promotion.zig and src/api/routes/promotion.zig (ENV-03's existing export/import/promote machinery) rather than duplicating it.

SECURITY NOTE (read before writing any query): the immediately preceding batch (WF02-batch-4-20260811) had a SECURITY-REVIEWER FAIL on PIN-01 for a cross-tenant data leak (INV-1) caused by referencing a SQL function (bpm_effective_tenant_id()) that no longer exists after the LEGACY_RLS-to-SCHEMA cutover -- the fix was tenant scope bound as a parameterized query argument, never a SQL-side session function or GUC. Apply the same pattern here: every new query you write that touches a tenant-scoped table (service_catalog, instances, tenant) must bind tenant_id as an explicit parameterized argument threaded from the real request/caller context, mirroring src/engine/pin_resolver.zig's resolveServiceCatalogRef() (already fixed, read it as the reference pattern) and src/repository/service_catalog.zig's getServiceForTenant(). This will be checked again by SECURITY-REVIEWER at Step 2c -- get it right the first time to avoid a repeat FAIL/rework cycle.

Write migrations under migrations/ for any new columns/tables the design specifies (e.g. INSTANCE_PINS_REBOUND event handling if it needs new columns -- check whether the existing event_store schema already supports arbitrary event types/payloads before adding anything new). Write unit and keep the build green throughout (zig build, zig build check). Do not write integration/end-to-end tests yourself -- that is TEST-DESIGNER's job next; you may add narrow unit tests colocated with the code you write, per standard convention.

IMPORTANT ENVIRONMENT NOTE: this shell's process environment may carry a STALE BPM_TEST_DB_URL inherited from a different workspace (hit earlier this session: env showed port 5453 instead of .env's real 5434). Before running any command that reads DB env vars (zig build migrate, test-env-verify, etc.), run `unset BPM_TEST_DB_URL BPM_DB_URL BPM_BENCH_DB_URL` first so `.env`'s values win. Confirm zig build test-env-verify reports HEALTHY before and after your changes.
acceptance_criteria: zig build check exits 0 (if this target exists in build.zig)
PIN-03 AC1/AC2/AC4/AC5 implemented per design; AC3 implemented exactly per the design's scoped structural substitute, not silently skipped

PIN-04 all 5 AC bullets implemented (replay reads only from event log, sub-process inheritance, conflict recording, GET pins endpoint with source event id, zero live-catalog reads during reconstruction)
PIN-05 all 5 AC bullets implemented (rebind endpoint, all-or-nothing, 409 on terminal instance, 422 UnknownPinRef with no partial apply, 422 on missing reason)

PRM-01 all 5 AC bullets implemented (403 + no review row without permission, added-only plan on empty target, 422 EmptyPromotionPlan, 422 InvalidPromotionSource, plan computed before any target-tenant write)
Every new tenant-scoped query binds tenant_id as a parameterized argument, never a SQL session function or GUC
zig build test-env-verify reports HEALTHY after changes

result.summary: Implemented PIN-03 (execution-time PinMissing enforcement via a new PIN_MISSING ErrorType feeding the existing SERVICE_TASK retry-then-dead-letter path, AC3 via the design's scoped structural substitute), PIN-04 (reconstructEffectivePins() in reconstruction.zig merges INSTANCE_STARTED + INSTANCE_PINS_REBOUND via pin_resolver.mergeEffectivePins(), sub-process child pin inheritance with conflict recording in startSubProcessesForPendingEventsInTx(), new GET /api/v1/instances/{id}/pins), PIN-05 (new src/engine/pin_rebind.zig rebindPins() + POST /api/v1/instances/{id}/rebind-pins, all-or-nothing, 409 on terminal instance, 422 UnknownPinRef/missing reason), and PRM-01 (new src/definition/promotion_plan.zig computePromotionPlan() diffing five dimensions across source/target tenants + new POST /api/v1/promotions, does NOT write promotion_reviews per the design's Classification rationale). One migration added (1154_pin05_instance_pins_rebound_event_type.sql, registers the new event type; not required for the write itself since it uses the same hand-rolled INSERT INTO events pattern SUBPROCESS_STARTED already uses, added for registry completeness). zig build/check/test all exit 0 (103/103 build steps, 1055/1135 tests passed, 80 pre-existing skips); zig build test-env-verify HEALTHY before and after. Every new tenant-scoped query binds tenant_id/actor_id/etc. as parameterized $N arguments via tenant_context_mod.set() SCHEMA-mode routing, mirroring promotion.zig's and pin_resolver.zig's established INV-1-safe pattern -- no bpm_effective_tenant_id() or session GUC introduced anywhere in this batch's new code. Two pre-existing, unrelated defects discovered during verification and filed (not fixed, per Unblock-Everything's scope boundary and No-Issue-Left-Local-Only): ISS-0687/GH-744 (clean_test_db.py's SYSTEM_ROLES reseed always silently fails, masked by a substring-matching guard) and ISS-0688/GH-745 BLOCKER (InstanceStore.create() regression -- two bpm_effective_tenant_id() calls that commit 584408611586c had already removed are back on main HEAD, breaking POST /api/v1/instances entirely in SCHEMA mode; confirmed pre-existing via git stash, not introduced by this batch). ISS-0688 will block TEST-DESIGNER's downstream integration tests for this batch's own requirements until fixed.

issues.description: ISS-0687 / GH-744: tools/clean_test_db.py's SYSTEM_ROLES reseed into `roles` always silently fails (wrong schema -- roles lives in tenant_default, the reseed runs unqualified against public), masked by run_psql()'s substring-matching 'does not exist' guard. Filed and queued, not fixed (out of scope for this batch).

ISS-0688 / GH-745: InstanceStore.create() (src/engine/instance.zig) contains two bpm_effective_tenant_id() calls that commit 584408611586c (SPT-03) had already removed -- confirmed present on main HEAD before this batch's own commits (git diff main shows zero changes at those lines), confirmed NOT introduced by this batch. Breaks POST /api/v1/instances entirely in SCHEMA mode (zig build test-integration-main: ee01_start_instance_test.zig 12/12 fail). Filed and queued as BLOCKER, not fixed inline (own diagnosis+fix+test cycle, out of this batch's PIN-03/04/05/PRM-01 scope). Flagging here because it will block TEST-DESIGNER's next step: any integration test that calls InstanceStore.create() to set up a fixture instance for PIN-03/04/05 testing will fail until ISS-0688 is fixed.

PIN-05's terminal-status set per docs/requirements.yaml is COMPLETED/CANCELLED/FAILED, but instance.zig's InstanceStatus enum (and instance_projections.status, an unconstrained TEXT column) has no FAILED value anywhere in this codebase -- only ERROR. src/engine/pin_rebind.zig's isTerminalStatus() treats the requirement's 'FAILED' as this codebase's 'ERROR', documented inline. Flagging for REQ-ANALYST/ORCH awareness in case the requirement text and the codebase's actual status vocabulary need reconciling.

PRM-01's permission_rule diff dimension: no table in this codebase associates a process_definition with specific required roles (role_permissions is a global resource/action grant on a role, not a per-definition binding). src/definition/promotion_plan.zig's diffPermissionRules() interprets this as role_permissions rows scoped to resource = process_key, documented inline as the chosen interpretation (mirrors the design's own 'BACKEND-DEV to confirm the exact table' note). Flagging for REQ-ANALYST confirmation.
